description: First step of converting a bank statement (PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 25 MB) into structured transactions. This never charges anything. Call it with file_path. It uploads the file and returns a quote: page count, credit cost (1 paid credit per 10 pages, rounded up), the user's paid balance, an upload_id and a confirm code. Show the user the cost. Only if they agree, call confirm_conversion to convert and charge.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the statement file on this computer.

upload_id.description: The upload_id from an earlier convert_document result, to quote that upload again.

name: convert_document
title: Quote converting a bank statement
